releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.2 — visual polish round. Chat, status, group and history rows no longer show the bright white band that appeared inside each glass card: the row shadow layer and tap ripple were composited as an opaque plate under the translucent fill, so both were replaced with the exact reference treatment (flat rgba(255,255,255,.7) fill, hairline highlight border, spring press scale). Settings is now the bright light-glass page it should be — the dark night theme that tinted every card grey-olive is gone, the page sits on the violet body gradient again, and the header carries the gradient profile card. Also: softer brand colour for the launcher icon and cheaper draws across all lists for smoother scrolling.
